name: EMRS Non-Teaching Staff Practice Mock - Practice Test 1

questions.question: In EMRS, what does the acronym EMRS stand for?
questions.hint: EMRS schools are set up by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for quality education of scheduled tribes.

questions.question: As a hostel warden, what is the primary duty towards students?
options: Enforce strict silent hours all day
Report every minor issue to police
questions.hint: Student welfare, counseling, safety, and health care are the warden's primary responsibilities.

questions.question: POCSO Act is related to the protection of:
questions.hint: POCSO stands for Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, enacted in 2012.

questions.question: What is the maximum age limit for child labor according to Indian law?
questions.hint: Child Labour Act bans employment of children below 14 years in any occupation.

questions.question: Which key is used to refresh a web page in a browser?
questions.hint: F5 is the standard browser command to reload the current page.

questions.question: What is the full form of PDF?
questions.hint: Adobe created the Portable Document Format (PDF) to present documents uniformly.

questions.question: A Junior Secretariat Assistant primarily handles:
questions.hint: JSA is a clerical post focused on data entry, dispatching mail, and file organization.

questions.question: In MS Word, Ctrl + Z is a shortcut key for:
questions.hint: Ctrl + Z reverses the last typing or formatting action in MS Office.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an input device of a computer?
questions.hint: A printer is an output device that produces physical hard copies.

questions.question: The system of maintaining official files by recording correspondence is called:
questions.hint: Filing keeps paper records organized in logical order.

questions.question: Which government portal is used for online public procurement in India?
questions.hint: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) allows departments to procure common services/goods online.

questions.question: If a student falls sick in the school hostel, what should the warden do first?
options: Provide first aid and take to medical room
questions.hint: Warden must render immediate care and check the student into the infirmary.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of rows in MS Excel 2016?
questions.hint: Modern versions of Excel support exactly 1,048,576 rows per worksheet.

questions.question: Which department in a government school handles salaries and ledger accounts?
questions.hint: Accounts handles budgeting, payments, salaries, and statutory deductions.

questions.question: Official communication sent from one department to another in the same organization is called:
questions.hint: OM (Office Memorandum) is a standard tool for inter-office or internal instructions.
